## Description

Pilot on flags with daily check-ins in week one, then exit gate review with evidence: two consecutive weeks of real bookings without paper fallback at both clinics; double-booking test result; median check-in; reminder delivery ≥ 98 % with failures visible; no open high/critical findings. Publish R1 release notes and known issues; turn J3 front-desk steps green in the journey specs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Evidence for each of the five exit criteria is attached and confirmed by founder, clinical advisor and one pilot user.
- [ ] **AC2.** If the holiday period prevents two consecutive weeks, the gate is formally moved to the first two full January weeks and recorded (no silent slip).
- [ ] **AC3.** R1 release notes list P1-01…P1-12 delivered status, known issues and what is not included (clinical notes, Rx, billing, AI, portal).
- [ ] **AC4.** Journey J3 front-desk steps (P-01, P-02, P-03) pass in Playwright.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
